behaviour: With the XCTest runner, a parallel run prints no 'coverage: off, because parallel testing is on' line, as the Swift Testing runner does. Xcode's workers' output isn't in the log, so the suite can't see the line either way.

With the XCTest runner, swift test --parallel runs each step of a scenario in its own process, so the steps lose their state and a different set of scenarios fails in each run. The suite compares only the exit status.
